configCapExceeds.title: Config cap exceeds tier RAG ceiling (default intents)
configCapExceeds.body: On default intents, effective RAG stays at {tierTokens} tokens (ChatCaps on {tierId}). The extra {unusedConfig} tokens in your YAML cap are not injected into chat for those queries. Only scaled pack/seed/slot knobs and intent floors change.

intentFloorsExceed.title: Intent floors can exceed the tier RAG cap
intentFloorsExceed.body: Conceptual floor → {conceptualRag} tokens; overview floor → {overviewRag} tokens — both above ChatCaps {tierTokens} on {tierId}. Overview and explanation queries will prefill more context than the tier's latency target assumes.

overviewCeilingOutruns.title: Overview slot ceiling outruns effective RAG
overviewCeilingOutruns.body: Theoretical overview ship max is {shipMax} tokens ({slots} retrieval slots × {slotTokens} tok/slot, plus pack/seed). Effective RAG for your intent is {effective} tokens — runtime Top-K and chunk budgeting trim what actually ships.

highMasterCap.title: High master cap scales all YAML knobs
highMasterCap.body: At {maxTokens} tokens, work-lane pack budget → {workLane}, overview pack max → {overviewMax}, anchor slots → {anchorSlots}. Expect heavier pack hydration, larger evidence fusion graphs, and more RAM at assemble time — even when chat RAG is tier-clamped.

aboveBaseline.title: Above ratio calibration baseline ({baseline})
aboveBaseline.body: Ratios in contextmint.defaults.yaml were tuned at baseline_tokens={baseline}. Higher caps linearly scale slot counts and per-slot token budgets until field clamps hit (e.g. work_lane_pack max 24k).

cpuLatency.title: CPU prefill + generation may exceed tier latency target
cpuLatency.body: Rough estimate on {tierId}: ~{prefill}s prefill ({effective} RAG + ~{fixedTokens} history/instructions/query at {rate} tok/s) + ~{gen}s generation ({maxGen} max_gen_tokens) ≈ {total}s total. Tier design target ≈ {latencyTarget}s. Health policy may reduce context under load.

kvCache.title: KV cache RAM estimate (CPU / Ollama)
kvCache.body: Full RAG + saturated history → input ≈ {inputEst} tokens; dynamic num_ctx ≈ {numCtx} (ceiling {ceiling}) → ~{kvGb} GB KV for a 3B-class model (~0.37 GB per 1k num_ctx), plus ~2 GB weights and OS headroom. Risk of swap or policy DOWNGRADE_AND_REDUCE on tight RAM.

gpuFixedCap.title: GPU tier: YAML scales; ChatCaps RAG cap is fixed
gpuFixedCap.body: GPU tiers (T3+) keep ChatCaps.context_tokens at {tierTokens}. Raising max_context_tokens mainly grows overview pack/seed slots and work-lane pack budget — not the hybrid RAG chunk cap. Cloud routing bypasses local ChatCaps entirely.

noFlags.title: No advisory flags for this combination
noFlags.body: For {tierId} at {maxTokens} tokens, effective RAG is {effective}. You can still raise or lower the cap freely; the matrix updates scaled YAML variables either way.

js.fallbackImpact: Adjust max_context_tokens to preview scaled YAML variables.
